headline: HuyenBao v11.39 — sửa AI i18n (VI), admin game-control tab, career exp+contract+raise, gigs popup glow
summary: BIG UPDATE. (1) AI EVENT I18N FIXED: 3 bugs caused AI events to render in English for Vietnamese players — stale closure (askAI had empty deps []), lazy lang init (defaulted to 'en' on first render), and no English-detection fallback. All fixed; AI events now render in the player's UI language. (2) ADMIN GAME-CONTROL TAB: new '🎮 Điều khiển' tab in /ads dashboard — grant any item (70+ items + 12 rare grails), set money/fame/health/spirit/level, trigger elections, advance game time. New /api/admin/game endpoint. (3) CAREER SYSTEM: full-time jobs now grant a 1-year contract + accumulate experience (XP per year). New actions: Negotiate raise (30-80% success based on exp+level+fame; 15% fire risk on failure) + Quit job (voluntary). Contract expiry triggers 8-25% fire chance per year (modified by experience + health). yearEnd adds experience + rolls firing. (4) GIGS POPUP: gigs moved from inline grid to a popup modal; trigger button GLOWS (pulsing amber ring) when gigs are ready + shows a badge count — so players notice new work without it eating vertical space.
features: AI I18N FIX: askAI deps [] → [lang]; lang lazy-inits from localStorage on first render; English-detection fallback in /api/story route
ADMIN GAME-CONTROL TAB (NEW): grant items, set money/fame/health/spirit/level, trigger elections, advance time — GET /api/admin/game lists all items, POST applies actions
CAREER: 1-year contract on FT hire; experience accumulates per year; Negotiate raise (30-80% success, 15% fire risk); Quit job; contract-expiry fire roll 8-25%/yr
CAREER UI: current-job card shows salary + experience XP bar + contract days remaining + raise/quit buttons
GIGS POPUP: inline grid → modal popup; trigger button glows amber when gigs ready + badge count
8 admin tabs now: Tổng quan · Hệ thống · Người chơi · Trò chuyện · Quà tặng · Bảng XH · CSDL · Điều khiển
